name: MuffinEMU Experimental
subtitle: Unfinished test builds, for testers.
description: Wii U on iPhone and iPad, done right. GamePad, TV, or both. Free and open source. These are unfinished test builds, published by hand to try out work in progress. Each one replaces an installed MuffinEMU: it has the same bundle identifier as the standard build, so your games, saves and settings carry over. They can crash or misbehave. For normal play use the Stable source instead.

apps.name: MuffinEMU Experimental
apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator - experimental test builds
apps.localizedDescription:
Wii U on iPhone and iPad. Play on-screen, use the GamePad, or switch to your TV. Free, open source, and built around Cemu.

Games, keys and system files are not included. Bring the games you own.

- Add games from Files: WUA, WUD/WUX, decrypted or encrypted with your own keys. Updates and DLC install in the app
- HD box art and game info find themselves: summaries, release dates and more
- Download art packs, including 3D boxes, or add your own covers in up to 4K
- Cards, large covers, 3D boxes, grid or list, any size, with sorting, grouping and renaming

[Serious Graphics]
- A Metal renderer built for Apple GPUs, with Vulkan as an option
- Graphic packs, resolution scaling and a brightness boost for dim scenes
- Bring your desktop Cemu shader caches and skip the stutter

[Speed]
- Plays out of the box
- Turn on JIT with StikDebug or LiveContainer for the full-speed recompiler. MuffinEMU offers to do it at launch

[The GamePad, Done Right]
- On-screen controls measured from a real Wii U GamePad, with skins, analog sticks and a layout editor
- Controllers work right alongside it
- One screen or both, iPhone portrait, or the TV picture on an external display

[Online]
- Pretendo Network with your own Wii U account files
- Custom servers, including ones you host at home

[Make It Yours]
- Per-game settings, Basic and Advanced modes, and one-tap settings backup
- 31 app icons with matching themes

Free, open source and updated constantly. Wii U on iOS, the way it should be.

Official Site: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/
Guides: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/docs/
Source code: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU
Report a problem: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU/issues

Legal

MuffinEMU is not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple. Wii U is a trademark of Nintendo. No copyrighted games, keys or firmware are distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
Experiment: release-9-9
Branch: release/9.9
Commit: ccf597a
Based on: main `21817d0` (v9.8), plus 25 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-12 18:15 UTC

- Speed up BC to ASTC texture transcodes on the GPU thread
- New Stick fine-tuning page: per-stick deadzones, sensitivity and invert with a live test circle, also in the in-game move-controls panel.
- none
- Zone: move and resize any button, or a whole group, from Move controls - per game if you like - with Reset this and Reset all
- Less time spent per draw on the GPU thread
- Sample the fine-grained GPU thread timers and keep the default stick path untouched
- Switch Showcase style and pick its colour from the in-game controls panel
- Change the A button size from the in-game controls panel
- Export everything from MuffinEMU in Settings so it can be imported into the new MuffinEMU.
- New: Record screen in the HOME menu saves gameplay video at the game's own resolution, with sound, to the Recordings folder in Files.
- Fixed the on-screen stick lagging behind your thumb when the Showcase look is on.
- Record screen: review fixes (autorelease pool, serialised start/stop, fragments, PTS, abort)
- Record screen saves in Full HD (1080p) or higher.

Experiment: Save states (same-session loads)
Branch: feature/save-states-stage0
Commit: 1a9129e
Based on: main `492ce96` (v7.2), plus 3 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 20:20 UTC

- Loading a save state now tells you exactly why it was refused, with an error code, and only says "loaded" once the game is drawing again.
- Loading a save state brings the graphics back in step with the restored game, and no longer gives up when the game is waiting on the screen to refresh.
- Loading a save state works after the game has started or stopped background tasks, and timers and sleeping threads carry on from where they were.
